verses.en: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.
verses.pt: Não te enfades por causa dos malfeitores, nem tenhas inveja dos que praticam a iniqüidade.
verses.en_web: Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.
verses.en_bbe: <Of David.> Do not be angry because of the wrongdoers, or have envy of the workers of evil.

verses.en: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
verses.pt: Pois em breve murcharão como a relva, e secarão como a erva verde.
verses.en_web: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.
verses.en_bbe: For they will quickly be cut down like grass, and become dry like the green plants.

verses.en: Trust in the LORD, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
verses.pt: Confia no Senhor e faze o bem; assim habitarás na terra, e te alimentarás em segurança.
verses.en_web: Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
verses.en_bbe: Have faith in the Lord, and do good; be at rest in the land, and go after righteousness.

verses.en: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
verses.pt: Deleita-te também no Senhor, e ele te concederá o que deseja o teu coração.
verses.en_web: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
verses.en_bbe: So will your delight be in the Lord, and he will give you your heart's desires.

verses.en: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
verses.pt: Entrega o teu caminho ao Senhor; confia nele, e ele tudo fará.
verses.en_web: Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
verses.en_bbe: Put your life in the hands of the Lord; have faith in him and he will do it.

verses.en: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.
verses.pt: E ele fará sobressair a tua justiça como a luz, e o teu direito como o meio-dia.
verses.en_web: he will make your righteousness go out as the light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
verses.en_bbe: And he will make your righteousness be seen like the light, and your cause like the shining of the sun.

verses.en: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
verses.pt: Descansa no Senhor, e espera nele; não te enfades por causa daquele que prospera em seu caminho, por causa do homem que executa maus desígnios.
verses.en_web: Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.
verses.en_bbe: Take your rest in the Lord, waiting quietly for him; do not be angry because of the man who does well in his evil ways, and gives effect to his bad designs.

verses.en: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
verses.pt: Deixa a ira, e abandona o furor; não te enfades, pois isso só leva à prática do mal.
verses.en_web: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret, it leads only to evildoing.
verses.en_bbe: Put an end to your wrath and be no longer bitter; do not give way to angry feeling which is a cause of sin.

verses.en: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.
verses.pt: Porque os malfeitores serão exterminados, mas aqueles que esperam no Senhor herdarão a terra.
verses.en_web: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.
verses.en_bbe: For the evil-doers will be cut off: but those who have faith in the Lord will have the earth for their heritage.

verses.en: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.
verses.pt: Pois ainda um pouco, e o ímpio não existirá; atentarás para o seu lugar, e ele ali não estará.
verses.en_web: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.
verses.en_bbe: For in a short time the evil-doer will be gone: you will go searching for his place, and it will not be there.

verses.en: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
verses.pt: Mas os mansos herdarão a terra, e se deleitarão na abundância de paz.
verses.en_web: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
verses.en_bbe: But the gentle will have the earth for their heritage; they will take their delight in peace without measure.

verses.en: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
verses.pt: O ímpio maquina contra o justo, e contra ele range os dentes,
verses.en_web: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.
verses.en_bbe: The sinner has evil designs against the upright, lifting up the voice of wrath against him.

verses.en: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.
verses.pt: mas o Senhor se ri do ímpio, pois vê que vem chegando o seu dia.
verses.en_web: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.
verses.en_bbe: He will be laughed at by the Lord, who sees that his day is coming.

verses.en: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.
verses.pt: Os ímpios têm puxado da espada e têm entesado o arco, para derrubarem o poder e necessitado, e para matarem os que são retos no seu caminho.
verses.en_web: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.
verses.en_bbe: The evil-doers have taken out their swords, their bows are bent; for crushing the poor, and to put to death those who are upright in their ways.

verses.en: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
verses.pt: Mas a sua espada lhes entrará no coração, e os seus arcos quebrados.
verses.en_web: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.
verses.en_bbe: But their swords will be turned into their hearts, and their bows will be broken.

verses.en: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.
verses.pt: Mais vale o pouco que o justo tem, do que as riquezas de muitos ímpios.
verses.en_web: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
verses.en_bbe: The little which the good man has is better than the wealth of evil-doers.

verses.en: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.
verses.pt: Pois os braços dos ímpios serão quebrados, mas o Senhor sustém os justos.
verses.en_web: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Yahweh upholds the righteous.
verses.en_bbe: For the arms of the evil-doers will be broken: but the Lord is the support of the good.

verses.en: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.
verses.pt: O Senhor conhece os dias dos íntegros, e a herança deles permanecerá para sempre.
verses.en_web: Yahweh knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.
verses.en_bbe: The days of the upright are numbered by the Lord, and their heritage will be for ever.

verses.en: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
verses.pt: Não serão envergonhados no dia do mal, e nos dias da fome se fartarão.
verses.en_web: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
verses.en_bbe: They will not be shamed in the evil time, and in the days when all are in need of food they will have enough.

verses.en: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.
verses.pt: Mas os ímpios perecerão, e os inimigos do Senhor serão como a beleza das pastagens; desaparecerão, em fumaça se desfarão.
verses.en_web: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of Yahweh shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.
verses.en_bbe: But the wrongdoers will come to destruction, and the haters of the Lord will be like the fat of lambs, they will be burned up; they will go up in smoke, and never again be seen.

verses.en: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.
verses.pt: O ímpio toma emprestado, e não paga; mas o justo se compadece e dá.
verses.en_web: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.
verses.en_bbe: The sinner takes money and does not give it back; but the upright man has mercy, and gives to others.

verses.en: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.
verses.pt: Pois aqueles que são abençoados pelo Senhor herdarão a terra, mas aqueles que são por ele amaldiçoados serão exterminados.
verses.en_web: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.
verses.en_bbe: Those who have his blessing will have the earth for their heritage; but those who are cursed by him will be cut off.

verses.en: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.
verses.pt: Confirmados pelo Senhor são os passos do homem em cujo caminho ele se deleita;
verses.en_web: A man’s goings are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.
verses.en_bbe: The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord, and he takes delight in his way.

verses.en: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.
verses.pt: ainda que caia, não ficará prostrado, pois o Senhor lhe segura a mão.
verses.en_web: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
verses.en_bbe: Even if he has a fall he will not be without help: for the hand of the Lord is supporting him.

verses.en: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
verses.pt: Fui moço, e agora sou velho; mas nunca vi desamparado o justo, nem a sua descendência a mendigar o pão.
verses.en_web: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.
verses.en_bbe: I have been young, and now am old, but I have not seen the good man without help, or his children looking for bread.

verses.en: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.
verses.pt: Ele é sempre generoso, e empresta, e a sua descendência é abençoada.
verses.en_web: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.
verses.en_bbe: All the day he is ready to have mercy and to give; his children are a blessing.

verses.en: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.
verses.pt: Aparta-te do mal e faze o bem; e terás morada permanente.
verses.en_web: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.
verses.en_bbe: Be turned from evil, and do good; and your place will be for ever.

verses.en: For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.pt: Pois o Senhor ama a justiça e não desampara os seus santos. Eles serão preservados para sempre, mas a descendência dos ímpios será exterminada.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord is a lover of righteousness, and takes care of his saints; they will be kept safe for ever; but the seed of the evil-doers will be cut off.

verses.en: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
verses.pt: Os justos herdarão a terra e nela habitarão para sempre.
verses.en_web: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.
verses.en_bbe: The upright will have the earth for their heritage, and will go on living there for ever.

verses.en: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.
verses.pt: A boca do justo profere sabedoria; a sua língua fala o que é reto.
verses.en_web: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
verses.en_bbe: The mouth of the good man says words of wisdom; the talk of his tongue is of righteousness.

verses.en: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.
verses.pt: A lei do seu Deus está em seu coração; não resvalarão os seus passos.
verses.en_web: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
verses.en_bbe: The law of his God is in his heart; he will never make a false step.

verses.en: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.
verses.pt: O ímpio espreita o justo, e procura matá-lo.
verses.en_web: The wicked watches the righteous, and seeks to kill him.
verses.en_bbe: The sinners are watching the upright man, desiring to put him to death.

verses.en: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
verses.pt: O Senhor não o deixará nas mãos dele, nem o condenará quando for julgado.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will not give him into their hands, or be against him when he is judged.

verses.en: Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.
verses.pt: Espera no Senhor, e segue o seu caminho, e ele te exaltará para herdares a terra; tu o verás quando os ímpios forem exterminados.
verses.en_web: Wait for Yahweh, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
verses.en_bbe: Be waiting for the Lord, and keep his way; and you will be lifted up, and have the land for your heritage: when the evil-doers are cut off, you will see it.

verses.en: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.
verses.pt: Vi um ímpio cheio de prepotência, e a espalhar-se como a árvore verde na terra natal.
verses.en_web: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
verses.en_bbe: I have seen the evil-doer in great power, covering the earth like a great tree.

verses.en: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
verses.pt: Mas eu passei, e ele já não era; procurei-o, mas não pôde ser encontrado.
verses.en_web: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
verses.en_bbe: But he came to an end, and there was no sign of him; I made a search for him and he was not there.

verses.en: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.
verses.pt: Nota o homem íntegro, e considera o reto, porque há para o homem de paz um porvir feliz.
verses.en_web: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
verses.en_bbe: Give attention to the good man, and take note of the upright; because the end of that man is peace.

verses.en: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.pt: Quanto aos transgressores, serão à uma destruídos, e a posteridade dos ímpios será exterminada.
verses.en_web: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.en_bbe: But as for the sinners, they will be cut off together; the end of the wrongdoers is destruction.

verses.en: But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD: he is their strength in the time of trouble.
verses.pt: Mas a salvação dos justos vem do Senhor; ele é a sua fortaleza no tempo da angústia.
verses.en_web: But the salvation of the righteous is from Yahweh. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
verses.en_bbe: But the Lord is the saviour of the upright: he is their strength in the time of trouble.

verses.en: And the LORD shall help them and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.
verses.pt: E o Senhor os ajuda e os livra; ele os livra dos ímpios e os salva, porquanto nele se refugiam.
verses.en_web: Yahweh helps them, and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked, and saves them, Because they have taken refuge in him.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord will be their help, and keep them safe: he will take them out of the hands of the evil-doers, and be their saviour, because they had faith in him.
